name: StormyLand Survival Season 11
description:
NOTE: This is a Whitelisted Server, you need to join the StormyLand Discord, and either message me or submit your Gamertag by filling out the form at https://stormyland.org

StormyLand Survival is a casual SMP server for everyone of all ages for both Bedrock and Java, whether you just want to play with friends, or create content, feel free to build, and explore, this is a 100% Survival Server, no cheats are used and everything that was built was made in vanilla survival mode.

This SMP operates in Seasons, we are currently on Season 11

Some basic rules

No Griefing

No Stealing, includes shops

No Cheating, includes duplicating items 

No Hacking, hacked clients of any kind are not aloud

No Killing for no reason, or being anoying in general

Please keep swearing to a minimum

If you play on a console, you can add "StormyLand S" as a friend on Xbox live and the server will show up under "Joinable Friends"

Subdomain Provided by FreeDNS(freedns.afraid.org)
